mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a labor market that is too hot and will soon lead to wage inflation, causing the Fed to tighten policy and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% y/y, it signals a weakening supply chain that will hurt corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO y/y growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 20% y/y, it signals over-exuberance in the housing market that will soon lead to a correction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST y/y growth > 20%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5pp in 3 months, it signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will hurt consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales growth slows by more than 2% y/y, it signals weakening consumer demand that will hurt corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where RSAFS y/y growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3%, it signals rising inflationary pressures that will cause the Fed to tighten policy, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3%.
